sloka: लङ्कायां दह्यमानायां शुशुभे स महार्णवः।छायासंसक्तसलिलो लोहितोद इवार्णवः ।। ६.७५.२८ ।।
transliteration: laṅkāyāṁ dahyamānāyāṁ śuśubhe sa mahārṇavaḥ।chāyāsaṁsaktasalilo lohitoda ivārṇavaḥ ।। 6.75.28 ।।

translations.english: In Lanka with the elephants set free, horses set free by the guards, it was like an agitated ocean at the end of the world cycle.
